'''Rasmal Desilijic Bansek''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was a member of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. During ancient [[Time/Legends|times]], Ramsmal defeated eight Hutt clans to secure the rights to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kor Desilijic]] within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The planet subsequently became the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of Desilijic. The [[Rasmal Valley Palace]], an opulent palace on Kor Desilijic, was later named after Rasmal.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
